$comment: The BASE READING step of the layered extraction: seven fields, all read off the printed document without needing a domain judgement. The other four scopes are RESERVED artifacts (`detection`, `desglose`, `rubro`, `clasificacion`); `test_the_extraction_steps_partition_every_field` proves the five together cover every field of the original 23-field contract exactly once. The two fields that asked *is this a receipt* (`comprobante_valido`, `motivo_rechazo`) live in `invoice_detection.json`, not here, because this prompt opens by asserting the document already WAS identified as a valid receipt — keeping the question in this contract would ask it of a model told not to ask it, and would make the contract answerable only about documents that are receipts. It carries no critical-severity field on purpose — the one field of the reading group that could only be CONFIRMED through an arithmetic combination (`importe_total_facturado`) moved to the step that holds that combination. The schema is a SEPARATE artifact from the prompt on purpose: the prompt says what to look for and how to read it, the schema says what shape the answer must have.

tipo_comprobante.description: the letter or the AFIP code printed in the header (001 Factura A, 006 Factura B, 011 Factura C), or 'null' when the document is not a fiscal receipt. 090/099 are 'comprobantes que no cumplen la RG 1415', not receipt classes

razon_social_emisor.description: the EMITTER's name as printed in the header, without labels like 'Razon Social:' or 'Cliente:'. It is the emitter's, never the recipient's

cuit_emisor.description: the EMITTER's CUIT, digits and its own hyphens only, format XX-XXXXXXXX-X. Never the recipient's. Cut the value at the first character that is not a digit or a hyphen, even if it is left incomplete

fecha_emision.description: the issue date as printed, DD/MM/YYYY. The issue date, not the due date and not the billing period

nro_comprobante.description: the receipt number printed beside 'Comp.Nro.' or 'Nro.', complete, with the hyphen if it has one. Not the point of sale, not the CAE, not an item code

moneda.description: the currency the document shows; 'ARS' when it shows none

notas.description: real observations printed on the receipt, or 'null'. Not a column header, not a summary of what you did, and not text in another language
